region_note: FARMED-ANIMAL SANCTUARY (upstate New York, takes farmed animals from the region)
notes: 3100 Aikens Road, Watkins Glen, NY 14891 (mail: P.O. Box 150). A national farmed-animal sanctuary in the Finger Lakes, about four and a half hours from the city; ask before bringing any animal. Main line 607-583-2225 ext. 221; general email info@farmsanctuary.org; shelter@farmsanctuary.org is the address its site gives for reporting how farmed animals are being treated. Read on its own site by a reviewer, 2026-11-05.
